question: List the full names of regular members (position = 'Member') who attended any 'Guest Speaker' event held at 'MU 215' where some amount was spent on 'Speaker Gifts', and calculate what percentage of all regular members they represent.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_034
    FROM member AS m
    INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN event AS e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
    WHERE m.XCL_038 = 'Member'
      AND e.XCL_013 = 'Guest Speaker'
      AND e.XCL_015 = 'MU 215'
      AND b.XCL_004 = 'Speaker Gifts'
      AND b.XCL_005 > 0
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE XCL_038 = 'Member'
)
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM total) AS percentage
FROM qualifying AS q
INNER JOIN member AS m ON q.XCL_034 = m.XCL_034

      AND b.XCL_004 = 'Speaker Gifts'
      AND b.XCL_005 > 0

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_034
    FROM member m
    JOIN attendance a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN event e ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
    JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
    WHERE e.XCL_013 = 'Guest Speaker'
      AND e.XCL_015 = 'MU 215'
      AND b.XCL_004 = 'Speaker Gifts'
      AND b.XCL_005 > 0
      AND m.XCL_038 = 'Member'
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE XCL_038 = 'Member'
)
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM total) AS percentage
FROM qualifying q
JOIN member m ON q.XCL_034 = m.XCL_034
